get.description:
Lists only team-owned webhook endpoints. Project-owned endpoints are excluded.

API keys require `webhooks:read`. Project tokens are not accepted.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Creates a synthetic project event and a traceable webhook delivery. An optional complete native envelope is accepted only with an exact HMS-enabled project session.

Requires `webhooks:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

WebhookBatchingInput.description: Opt-in native webhook conversation batching beta. On create, omission keeps single-event delivery. On PATCH, omission preserves the stored batching settings. Requires feature availability and enrollment. Events without replayable conversation payloads use single delivery.

WebhookEventBatch.description: Version 1 batch of existing native event objects. A retry keeps this ID, membership, order and JSON bytes. Acknowledge the whole request with 2xx; partial acknowledgement is unsupported.

TestProjectWebhookInput.description: Names reserved for internal use are rejected with HTTP 400, whether supplied as eventType or in the native event body, before a test event or delivery is created.

data.description: Canonical base64 for the complete native webhook body; decoded bytes are limited to 65,536 bytes.

eventTypes.description: Names reserved for internal use cannot be newly subscribed. Existing stored entries may be preserved during updates but never match deliveries.

value.description: Encrypted write-only HTTP field value. Limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Line breaks, NUL, and other control characters except horizontal tab are rejected.
